    '''
    Given a string of words, return a list of words split on whitespace, if no whitespaces exists in the text you
    should split on certain characters, if no such characters exists you should return the number of lower-case letters with odd order in the
    alphabet, ord('a') = 0, ord('b') = 1, ... ord('z') = 25
    '''

Clarification: Using ord(i) % 2 == 0 with ord('a')=0-based indexing as stated in the docstring (ord('a')=0, ord('b')=1, ...) -- so a letter counts if its 0-indexed alphabet position is even (a=0, c=2, e=4, etc).
